entries.8add313b8f5122f8: This is a single-segment business that manufactures and sells concrete and metal products for civil engineering and undertakes construction contracts. This business combines segments (including steel segments and composite segments), which are structural members for tunnels, RC civil engineering products and processed steel products; revenue of ¥28,858 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026 accounts for all of consolidated revenue. The company manufactures and sells products and undertakes incidental construction work, and also receives contract manufacturing of products from its parent company, Nippon Steel. Part of its manufacturing is outsourced to its consolidated subsidiary Geofakuto, and it purchases raw materials for civil engineering products from that subsidiary. Production sites are the Kanaya Plant (Shimada, Shizuoka Prefecture), Hashimoto Plant (Hashimoto, Wakayama Prefecture), Higashi-Matsuyama Plant (Higashi-Matsuyama, Saitama Prefecture), Fukuoka Plant (Iizuka, Fukuoka Prefecture) and Ibaraki Plant (Inashiki, Ibaraki Prefecture).
